name: term-fleet
description: Share a machine's PTY sessions over one WebSocket with desktop and mobile clients

scripts.build:daemon: pnpm run build:web && go build -o bin/tfd ./cmd/tfd
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm run build:web && go build -o bin/tfdesktop ./cmd/tfdesktop
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && go build -o bin/tfd ./cmd/tfd && go build -o bin/tfrelay ./cmd/tfrelay && go build -o bin/tfdesktop ./cmd/tfdesktop
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:web && go run ./cmd/tfd -web-dir internal/web/dist
scripts.dev:desktop: pnpm run build:web && go run ./cmd/tfdesktop -web-dir internal/web/dist
scripts.acceptance:relay: pnpm run build:daemon && pnpm run build:relay && node scripts/relay-acceptance.mjs
scripts.check: go vet ./... && pnpm --dir web run typecheck
scripts.acceptance:relay-browser: pnpm run build:daemon && pnpm run build:relay && node scripts/relay-browser.mjs
scripts.acceptance:all: pnpm run acceptance && pnpm run acceptance:relay && pnpm run acceptance:relay-browser
